basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 82 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar), Odisha, has invited applications for 82 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. RECT-11012/4/2026-RECU SEC. The posts include Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor. Applications are accepted online until 13 December 2026.

application_fee.sc_fee: ₹2,400 (Refundable for those candidates who appear for the interview)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online/digital mode only, at the time of submission of the online application.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Medical candidates: a recognised medical qualification (IMC Act 1956 schedules) with MD/MS or equivalent, and/or DM/M.Ch for superspecialities, plus 0 to 14 years teaching/research experience by post. Non-medical candidates: Master degree with Doctorate in the discipline (e.g. M.Sc. Medical Anatomy with PhD), plus 3 to 14 years experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Medical qualification in I or II schedule or part II of third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956; MD/MS or recognised equivalent in the respective discipline/subject; AND/OR M.Ch. (surgical) / D.M. (medical) superspeciality (2, 3 or 5 years course) or equivalent; Non-medical: Master degree in discipline/allied subject and Doctorate of a recognised University. Experience required: 14 years after MD/MS; or 12 years after 2/5-year M.Ch./D.M.; or 11 years for 3-year D.M./M.Ch.; non-medical 14 years after Doctorate. Age limit: Maximum 58 years. Pay: Level 14-A of the Pay Matrix i.e., Minimum Pay of Rs.1,68,900 . (Plus, NPA for medically qualified candidates only). Qualification required: Medical: medical qualification and MD/MS or equivalent; 10 years exp

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,01,500 to Rs. 1,68,900, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Apply only online on https://aiimsbhubaneswar.nic.in/; the link is activated from the date of publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
Fill a separate online form and pay a separate fee for each post.
Pay the fee online/digital mode at the time of submitting the online application.
Send the signed hard copy of the online form with self-attested documents by Speed Post/Courier.
Hard copy must reach the Institute within 7 days from the cut-off date.
Super-scribe envelope: Application for the post of ____ in the Department of ____.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 82 vacancies: 28 Professor, 12 Additional Professor, 16 Associate Professor, 26 Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 13 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General / EWS / OBC: ₹3,000. SC / ST: ₹2,400 (Refundable for those candidates who appear for the interview). PwBD / Women: Exempted (No application fee is payable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Professor: maximum 58 years; Additional Professor: maximum 58 years; Associate Professor: maximum 50 years; Assistant Professor: maximum 50 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 05 Years, OBC 03 Years, PwBD 10 Years, Government Servant 05 Years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 14-A of the Pay Matrix i.e., Minimum Pay of Rs.1,68,900 . (Plus, NPA for medically qualified candidates only) for Professor, Level 13-A2+ of the Pay Matrix i.e., Minimum Pay of Rs.1,48,200 (Plus NPA for medically qualified candidates only) for Additional Professor, Level 13-A1+ of the Pay Matrix i.e., Minimum Pay of Rs.1,38,300 (Plus NPA for medically qualified candidates only) for Associate Professor, Level 12 of the Pay Matrix i.e., Minimum Pay of Rs.1,01,500 (Plus NPA for medically qualified candidates only) with provision to move to Level 13 of the Pay Matrix after three years. for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Medical candidates: a recognised medical qualification (IMC Act 1956 schedules) with MD/MS or equivalent, and/or DM/M.Ch for superspecialities, plus 0 to 14 years teaching/research experience by post. Non-medical candidates: Master degree with Doctorate in the discipline (e.g. M.Sc. Medical Anatomy with PhD), plus 3 to 14 years experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Government servants must obtain prior permission from present employer before applying and produce NOC at interview/document verification. PwBD reservation only for not less than 40% disability; subject to Medical Board evaluation. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must be valid for 2026-27 and issued on or after 01.04.2026. EWS certificate must be issued during the current financial year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates convicted by any Court of Law. Government servants without NOC will not be permitted to appear for the interview. No age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying for Unreserved vacancies.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by Screening Committee based on application. Screening test, if required, when a large number of candidates apply. Interview. Screening Committee may shortlist candidates for interview based on application.
